en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's read a dirty book
Let's read manga
This is boring...
N-No! Gentlemen no read that stuff!
Shuichi should train body and mind instead!
Yeah! Gonta like books with pictures.

Pictures explain complicated stuff easy!
Easy for Gonta to understand!

Gonta think books like that easy to read
cuz nice people write them.
But Gonta like boring stuff.

Can relax, think happy thoughts when Gonta
have nothing to do.

Also, forest family always say, being bored 
can lead to happiness.

Cuz everyone have to figure out what
make them happy.
Being bored good as long as you happy.
<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta's "forest family"...

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Gonta's inner thoughts...?
